close_reason: Default query_subtree impl now propagates query_objects errors via '?'. Filter construction uses Default + field mutation (no fallible deserialise path). New regression test query_subtree_default_impl_propagates_query_objects_err uses MockBackend::set_query_objects_err to inject a backend error and asserts both that Err is returned and the message is carried through. Committed in eec6d59. Gates: fmt/clippy/test/doc green.
description:
src/backend.rs:170-188 (the default query_subtree impl): 'if let Ok(result) = self.query_objects(...) { ... } // non-fatal on Err: skip this node's children'.

The default trait impl is the only impl available unless the consumer overrides it. The trait doc at src/backend.rs:128-130 says 'The default implementation calls query_objects with a parentId filter once per level — O(max_depth) backend calls.' The doc does NOT say errors are swallowed.

Trigger: any transient backend error (DB timeout, connection drop, lock contention) on the per-level query_objects call. Bad behavior: the descendant set is silently truncated. Two visible consequences in the handlers that call query_subtree:

1. FileNode/query with depth > 0: response 'ids' is missing the descendant nodes that should have been returned. Client sees a partial subtree with no indication it is partial.

2. (Indirectly) any future consumer using query_subtree to enumerate a subtree for cascade-destroy will under-report the descendants and leave orphans in the tree.

Required: propagate the Err via '?' (Result<Vec<Id>, Self::Error>) — the signature already returns Result. The silent-skip pattern at backend.rs:188 is also incompatible with the workspace 'No silent-drop is a server-side query-correctness bug' policy (workspace AGENTS.md, Filter algebra exclusion section, reason #1).

If the design intent is truly best-effort, the trait doc must say so and the handler call sites must surface partiality to the client (e.g., a 'truncated: true' field on the response). Currently neither is true.
title: FileNodeBackend::query_subtree default impl silently swallows query_objects errors
